stem: Meera watches the Sun from the terrace of her house in Jaipur. It rises in the east in the morning and sets in the west in the evening. Why does the Sun appear to move from east to west across the sky?

options.text: The Sun revolves around Earth once every day.
Earth rotates on its own axis from west to east.
Earth revolves around the Sun from east to west.
The Sun rotates on its axis from east to west.

teacher.key_rationale: The apparent daily east-to-west motion of the Sun is caused by Earth's rotation on its axis from west to east, so B is correct. A wrongly has the Sun orbiting Earth daily, C confuses revolution with rotation, and D attributes the effect to the Sun's own rotation.
